description: Hybrid trigger: fires ONLY when TCN confidence (edge+confirm+cooldown, same as v6b tcn_trigger) AND rule-base physics gate (instantaneous wrist speed/reach past PUNCH_ARM/PUNCH_EXTEND) are BOTH true. Uses the leakage-safe model trained in motion_learning/v6b_tcn_trigger (TEST_GT 15 events excluded from training, see eval/runs/v5b_tcn_trigger/EXPERIMENT_REPORT.md).
